svg.text: Phase 2 — the input edges, the assembled binary, the image and the checks
Task groups 2.6 to 2.9 and 2.1. The four boxes on the bottom row have no predecessor at all.
the two sources of test input
the image build lane, landed first
the node image and its entrypoint
No predecessor — schedulable at any point in the phase
The check lane is the phase's own acceptance made repeatable: it runs the
assembled binary against a recorded input file and a test sender, then asserts
the resulting event stream — and runs it a second time with the input switched
off, where the expected result is no tracked vehicle at all.
